description: This file provides inline implementations of various functional embedding operations for the PyTorch library, including functions for one-hot encoding, embedding, and embedding bag. It also contains internal detail namespace functions for renormalization and specialized embedding behavior.

methods.name: Tensor one_hot(const Tensor & tensor,int64_t num_classes=-1)
methods.description: Performs one-hot encoding on a tensor given number of classes.

methods.name: Tensor embedding(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const EmbeddingFuncOptions & options={})
methods.description: Computes the embedding of input tensor with given weight matrix, optional padding index, max normalization, and other parameters.

methods.name: Tensor embedding_bag(const Tensor & input,const Tensor & weight,const EmbeddingBagFuncOptions & options={})
methods.description: Computes embedding bag, which aggregates embeddings from input indices with options for mode, offsets, and other parameters.
